edits.field_name: Beneficiary document type and identification number
edits.current: COMPOSITE FIELD as drafted in the resolution - numeral 2 names BOTH the document type and the number in a single numeral, and the technical specification splits them into two columns. Sub-field 1 = the identity-document type code; sub-field 2 = the identification number without dots or hyphens. PERSISTENCE: this pair is the join key across every Colombian artefact for the employee - electronic payroll NIE044 / NIE045, PILA Record Tipo 2 campos 3 and 4, Form 220 casillas 24 and 25.
edits.proposed: COMPOSITE FIELD as drafted in the resolution - numeral 2 names BOTH the document type and the number in a single numeral, and the technical specification splits them into two columns. Sub-field 1 = the DIAN identity-document type code from the 'Tipo de documento (numerals 2 and 34)' table on the Field Options sheet; sub-field 2 = the identification number without dots or hyphens, kept as text so leading zeros survive. SOURCE AT PMI: the client master data has no type-code field - it stores the number in one column per document type (Citizenship Card ID, Indentity Card for Foreigners, Identity Card, National ID). The engine must hold an explicit Employee.Document_Type, derived once from the populated column through a client-confirmed mapping, with a priority rule where more than one column is filled. POPULATION: the record is required for EVERY person paid in the tax year, including leavers and employer-paid pensioners who are not in the current master-data snapshot - their document type and number must be retained after termination. Where a payment is made to a payee other than the employee (the client's accumulators carry a separate 'Beneficiary National Id', mostly on pension payments), the identity reported is that of the beneficiary of the payment - to be confirmed with RA. PERSISTENCE: this pair is the join key across every Colombian artefact for the employee - electronic payroll NIE044 / NIE045, PILA Record Tipo 2 campos 3 and 4, Form 220 casillas 24 and 25.
edits.reason: The field is right, but the client data does not hold a document-type code: Master Data has one column per document type (AM National ID, AN Identity Card, AO Indentity Card for Foreigners, AP Citizenship Card ID). Of 263 Master Data rows, 234 have only AP, 13 only AO, 13 have two or three of these columns filled (e.g. AM+AP on 8 rows) and 2 have none, so a priority rule is needed. Master Data covers only the 263 current payroll people: of 1,038 persons in the Accumulated Report, 491 are pensioners (WT 62154 Monthly Retired Pension) and 286 are other people (mostly leavers) who are in neither Master Data nor Base of Withholding; for them the only identity is Accumulated C 'EE Citizenship Card ID' (no type). Accumulated D 'Beneficiary National Id' is filled for 345 persons (330 of them pensioners) and differs from C for 334 of them, i.e. a payee other than the employee/pensioner exists for some payments; the spec does not say whose identity numeral 2 carries in that case. Values are text with leading zeros (e.g. '0244621'), so the AN typing is correct. Option Values is '-' although the spec's Field Options sheet already holds the DIAN document-type catalogue for numerals 2 and 34.

The resolution names one numeral; the technical specification splits it into four columns - first surname, second surname, first given name, other given names - in the same order as every other DIAN artefact. Sub-field order matters: DIAN matches on the surname columns. SOURCE AT PMI: first surname = master-data Last Name; second surname = Second Last Name (blank allowed); first given name = First Name; other given names = Middle Name (blank allowed). edits.current: COMPOSITE FIELD - department and municipality of the beneficiary, on the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue. Note that this is the BENEFICIARY's location, not the place of work reported in the electronic payroll (NIE051 / NIE052) nor the place where the withholding was practised reported in Form 220 (casillas 34 / 35). Three artefacts, three different geographic questions.
edits.proposed: COMPOSITE FIELD - department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) of the beneficiary, on the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue. Note that this is the BENEFICIARY's location, not the place of work reported in the electronic payroll (NIE051 / NIE052) nor the place where the withholding was practised reported in Form 220 (casillas 34 / 35). Three artefacts, three different geographic questions. SOURCE AT PMI: the client stores a letter department code and a free-text city, so the system must hold the beneficiary's DIVIPOLA department and municipality codes as master data (or convert through a maintained mapping table validated against DIVIPOLA); free text must never be sent. The value for a beneficiary whose address is outside Colombia must be confirmed against the Formato 2276 v4 technical specification (RA). Location must be retained for leavers and employer-paid pensioners.
edits.reason: Spec format is N (DIVIPOLA) 2 + 3 digits (e.g. 11 / 001). The client holds the department as a letter code (AV: DC 127, ANT 60, CUN 28, VAC 20, ATL 8, ... plus foreign region codes ON, VD, JAL) and the municipality as free text (AR: 60 distinct spellings, e.g. 'Bogota', 'Bogota D.C.', 'BOGOTA', 'bogota', 'Santafe de Bogota D.C.', 'Suba Compartir', 'Cundinamarca'). No DANE code exists in any mapped report. Seven Master Data persons have a foreign address (AQ Country CA, CR/cr, DO, CH, MX) for which no DIVIPOLA code exists; the spec does not say what to report. Pensioners and leavers have no address at all in the mapped reports.

edits.current: Annual salary payments to the employee. Maps to Form 220 casilla 36 and must equal it for the same employee and year.
edits.proposed: Annual salary payments to the employee: ordinary and integral salary (100% of the integral salary - the 70% factor applies only to contribution bases), salary arrears, overtime and surcharges, and other remuneration that constitutes salary under CST art. 127 and is not reported in a more specific numeral. Fed by an explicit wage-type-to-numeral classification table, NOT by the payroll 'salary' indicator: at PMI that indicator also marks vacation pay and per diems, which belong to numerals 12 and 13. Each wage type feeds exactly one numeral. Accumulated on the PAYMENT date for 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; rolling or non-calendar accumulators must not be used. Maps to Form 220 casilla 36 and must equal it for the same employee and year.
edits.reason: Salary is evidenced: BW E equals Accumulated 62100+62140 for September on 261 of 262 rows. The client flags salary items with Accumulated H 'Salary Payment Indicator' = X on 2,866 rows: 62100, 62101, 62113, 62116, 62118, 62133, 62140, 62141, 62150 Vacation Bonus, 62208/62209/62210 bonuses, 62225, 62228, 62805-62808 per diems, 62841/62842/62845 overtime and the 794xx leave payouts. That flag also covers items the spec routes elsewhere (vacation pay to numeral 12, per diems to numeral 13), so the explanation must say numeral 5 is fed by a wage-type-to-numeral classification, not by the salary flag, and that no amount may enter two numerals. Integral salary (62140, 103 rows) is reported in full here (the 70% factor applies only to social-security bases). Accumulated Report monthly columns I..T are 01/01/2026..01/09/2026 then 01/10/2025..01/12/2025 (a rolling Oct-2025..Sep-2026 window) and column U 'Total' equals the sum of all 12 months on every one of 86,610 rows, although the title row reads 'Report generation date 01-01-2026 - 2026-09-30'. U 'Total' therefore cannot be used as an annual 2276 amount.

edits.field_name: Excess meal payments over 41 UVT (ET art. 387-1)
edits.current: The EXCESS over 41 UVT per month (COP 2,147,334 in 2026) of employer payments to third parties for the employee's or their family's meals. Taxable income of the employee. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 32, which carries the amount UP TO 41 UVT and is informative only - the same underlying payment is split across two numerals at the 41-UVT line, and the engine must maintain that split monthly.
edits.proposed: The EXCESS over 41 UVT per month (COP 2,147,334 in 2026) of employer payments to third parties for the employee's or their family's meals. Taxable income of the employee. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 32, which carries the amount UP TO 41 UVT and is informative only - the same underlying payment is split across two numerals at the 41-UVT line. The split is computed MONTH BY MONTH per employee with the UVT of the payment year, and only where that month's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026); where it does, the whole month's payment goes to numeral 7 and both numerals 8 and 32 stay nil for that month. Source: the meal-allowance-in-kind wage type(s) tagged as 'meal paid to a third party' in the wage-type classification (at PMI the candidate is 'Meal Allowance Inf.' - client to confirm that it is paid to a food supplier).
edits.reason: The client pays a meal allowance in kind (65818 'Meal Allowance Inf.', offset by deduction 21115) to 447 persons; monthly amounts range from 293,314 to 4,488,000 and 10 person-months exceed 41 UVT (2,147,334). WT 58001 UVT = 52,374 in 2026 (49,799 in 2025), confirming the spec's thresholds. 91 meal recipients have a monthly salary (62100/62140) above 310 UVT (16,235,940), so the whole-payment rule matters for this client. The explanation does not tell the developer which wage type feeds the split or that the 41-UVT and 310-UVT tests are monthly per employee using the UVT of the payment year. Whether 65818 is a payment to a third-party food supplier (the art. 387-1 condition) must be confirmed with the client.

edits.current: Statutory benefits OTHER THAN severance and its interest, which have their own three numerals (18, 19, 20). Service bonus, vacation pay and work clothing. Maps to Form 220 casilla 42.
edits.proposed: Statutory benefits OTHER THAN severance and its interest, which have their own three numerals (18, 19, 20): legal service bonus (prima de servicios), vacation pay (enjoyed, compensated in cash, or paid on termination) and work clothing. Fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification; a wage type classified here must be excluded from numeral 5 even where it is flagged as salary in payroll (at PMI vacation pay and the vacation bonus carry the salary flag). Whether extralegal bonuses (e.g. vacation bonus, March/Christmas/August bonuses) are reported here or in numeral 5 / 17 must be fixed per wage type and confirmed with RA. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Maps to Form 220 casilla 42.
edits.reason: Statutory benefits are evidenced: 62211 Service Legal Bonus (paid mainly in 12/2025 and 06/2026), vacation pay 79401 Annual leave payout, 79403 Vacations Compensated In cash, 62116 Vacation Terminations, and 62150 Vacation Bonus. 79401, 62116 and 62150 carry Salary Payment Indicator X, so without an explicit rule they would also be picked up as salary (numeral 5). The client also has extralegal bonuses (62208 March, 62209 Christmas, 62210 August, 62228/62229 seniority) - the explanation does not say whether extralegal bonuses belong here or in numeral 5/17. No work-clothing wage type exists. The explanation names the concepts but not the classification that feeds them.

edits.field_name: Severance deposited to the severance fund
edits.current: THE SECOND OF THREE. The amount DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen fund by 14 February under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99. MAPS TO FORM 220 CASILLA 49 - NOT casilla 48. The second and third severance lines are TRANSPOSED between the two artefacts, and a positional mapping swaps them.
edits.proposed: THE SECOND OF THREE. The amount DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen fund under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 (deadline 14 February of the following year). Source: the severance-fund payment wage type (at PMI 'Payment Severance Funds Inf.' - take ONE of the two mirror wage types, never both). The tax year in which a February deposit is reported (year of deposit or year the severance accrued) must be stated - RA to confirm the governing rule before build. MAPS TO FORM 220 CASILLA 49 - NOT casilla 48. The second and third severance lines are TRANSPOSED between the two artefacts, and a positional mapping swaps them.
edits.reason: Evidenced: the fund deposit is booked once a year, in 01/02/2026 only (236 rows, WT 25827 and its mirror 65805 with identical totals 2,064,808,759). The deposit made in February 2026 relates to severance accrued in 2025. The explanation says 'deposited by 14 February' but does not tell the developer in which tax year's return a February deposit is reported (year of deposit vs year of accrual), and the mirror wage types create a double-count risk.

edits.current: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER. Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Nil for ordinary corporate payroll, where the paying fund is the withholding agent and the reporting party.
edits.proposed: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER (retirement, old-age or invalidity). Populated for every employer-paid pensioner: at PMI the employer pays company pensions directly (monthly pension and additional pension wage types), so this numeral is NOT nil for this client and the pensioner population (not present in the employee master data) must be included in the file. Fed by the pension wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification; whether lump-sum retirement payments and pension-related compensations belong here or in numeral 17 must be confirmed per wage type with RA. Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Where a fund pays the pension, the fund is the withholding agent and reporting party and nothing is reported here.
edits.reason: The spec says this numeral is 'Nil for ordinary corporate payroll', and the Payroll Scope Summary has only a NO row for fund-paid pensions. The client data contradicts that assumption for PMI: the employer pays pensions directly to 491 pensioners (62154 Monthly Retired Pension, every month; 62153 Additional Retirement Pension, 485 persons), plus 62151/62152 Retirement Payment, withholds tax on them (21140 Withholding-Retirees) and deducts pensioner health (21645/21646/21647) and solidarity (21643). Pensioners are in neither Master Data nor Base of Withholding. The numeral itself is right; the explanation must tell the developer this population exists and which wage types feed it. The 1,000-UVT monthly test (52,374,000) matches WT 58001 UVT 52,374.

edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING NUMERAL. For a RESIDENT it is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Maps to Form 220 casilla 60, and the sum across the population reconciles to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93.
edits.proposed: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING NUMERAL: the income-tax withholding actually practised on the beneficiary's work or pension income in the tax year, by payment date. For a RESIDENT it is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Source: every wage type that records withholding actually practised and remitted (at PMI the candidates are the employee income-tax wage type and the separate withholding wage types for terminations, retirees and equity awards). Notional, theoretical or hypothetical tax-equalisation amounts are included ONLY if they were actually withheld and declared on Form 350 - each wage type to be confirmed with the client and RA. Maps to Form 220 casilla 60, and the sum across the population reconciles to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93.
edits.reason: Withholding is evidenced in several places. For September, BW V 'WITH CONTRIBUTION' equals WT 2552 on 255 of 262 rows; BW X 'WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION' equals 2552 on only 201 rows (V = X on 204 rows). The 6 remaining employees (integral salary) have 2552 = 0 and their V equals WT 21330 'Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical)'. Other withholding wage types exist: 21129 Withholding-Terminations, 21140 Withholding-Retirees (pensioners), 25832 Withholding Tax on Stock awards, 25833 Withholding Tax IC Local Country, 25834 Hypothetical Withholding Tax IC Foreign Country, plus BW Y CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING. The explanation does not say which wage types make up 'Income_Tax_Withheld'. Which BW column (V or X) reflects the withholding actually practised, and whether 'Theoretical'/'Hypothetical' (tax-equalisation) amounts and contingent withholding are included, is a client/RA decision - recorded, not decided here.

edits.current: INFORMATIVE ONLY. Res. 227 para. 1 says expressly: 'El value a que hace referencia el numeral 32 de este art. SE CONSIDERA DE CARACTER INFORMATIVO y corresponde a lo dispuesto en el art. 387-1 del Tax Code'. It therefore does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22 - the amount is not income of the employee at all, but of the food supplier. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 8, which carries the excess above 41 UVT. Form 220 has NO counterpart casilla for this amount.
edits.proposed: INFORMATIVE ONLY. Res. 227 para. 1: the value of numeral 32 is informative and corresponds to ET art. 387-1. It does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 8, which carries the excess above 41 UVT. Form 220 has NO counterpart casilla. Computed MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the meal payment to a third party up to 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), only in months where the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026). Source: the meal-allowance-in-kind wage type(s) tagged as 'meal paid to a third party' (at PMI the candidate is 'Meal Allowance Inf.' - client to confirm it is paid to a food supplier).
edits.reason: The client pays a meal allowance in kind (65818 'Meal Allowance Inf.', offset by deduction 21115) to 447 persons; monthly amounts range from 293,314 to 4,488,000 and 10 person-months exceed 41 UVT (2,147,334). WT 58001 UVT = 52,374 in 2026 (49,799 in 2025), confirming the spec's thresholds. 91 meal recipients have a monthly salary (62100/62140) above 310 UVT (16,235,940), so the whole-payment rule matters for this client. The explanation does not tell the developer which wage type feeds the split or that the 41-UVT and 310-UVT tests are monthly per employee using the UVT of the payment year. Whether 65818 is a payment to a third-party food supplier (the art. 387-1 condition) must be confirmed with the client.

edits.proposed: The fiscal year whose payments are reported (AAAA). Every amount numeral (5 to 33) is the sum of payments or credits in account made between 1 January and 31 December of this year, by PAYMENT date - never a rolling twelve-month window or an accumulator spanning two calendar years. edits.reason: Accumulated Report monthly columns I..T are 01/01/2026..01/09/2026 then 01/10/2025..01/12/2025 (a rolling Oct-2025..Sep-2026 window) and column U 'Total' equals the sum of all 12 months on every one of 86,610 rows, although the title row reads 'Report generation date 01-01-2026 - 2026-09-30'. U 'Total' therefore cannot be used as an annual 2276 amount. The spec's Population Rules sheet already says to accumulate each concept for the whole tax year on the PAYMENT date, but neither this field nor the amount fields say so; a developer reusing the client's accumulator would mix Oct-Dec of the prior year into the return.
